title: Material Blend 2-Mix Duo #30 (나비날개비늘+금박 / 나비날개비늘+스테인드글라스)
prompt:
Professional fashion photograph, full body shot. TWO women standing side by side, each with her own multi-material blended body.

#1: THE ABSOLUTE DARKEST BLACK SKIN ON EARTH blue-black void complexion darker than night sky, mid 40s goddess, wide hip narrow physique THE MOST EXTREME PHYSICALLY POSSIBLE beyond all anatomy limits — hips so impossibly wide extending beyond frame creating the most extreme hip-to-waist ratio ever, waist cinched to absolute impossible minimum, upper body slim emphasizing the dramatic hip explosion, curtain bangs long straight hair sweeping past the shoulders — her entire body, from neck to ankle, is a random intermingled mix of two materials with no spatial division at all — not left versus right, not top versus bottom, but irregular patches of each scattered all over her body in a marbled, organic distribution, exactly like natural mineral veining. butterfly scales (thousands of microscopic powder-fine scales layered like overlapping roof tiles, each scale individually distinct catching its own glint), BLAZING ELECTRIC VIOLET scale formations, VIVID MAGENTA scale-edge detail, every scale catching its own glint and casting its own small shadow and applied ELECTRIC CRIMSON leaf, thin irregular metallic sheets laid onto the contour of her body with fine natural creases and overlapping seams, VIVID GOLD undertone glinting through the thinnest points are woven through each other everywhere: a patch of one material on one shoulder, immediately beside it a patch of the other, then the first again across the ribs, the second at the hip, the first down one thigh, the second across the opposite calf — the two materials never separating into a clean zone anywhere on her body, every square inch densely interlocking, no fabric no seam no garment anywhere, every material fused to or erupting from her own living skin, covering her completely with no bare skin anywhere from neck to ankle. Pose: strong hip pop right, both hands pressing sides of hips outward simultaneously arching back to extreme — most extreme wide hip narrow silhouette ever displayed.
#1: extreme platform heels/boots blending the relevant materials at her feet, extra long nails each matching whichever zone that hand falls in.

#2: THE ABSOLUTE DARKEST BLACK SKIN ON EARTH blue-black void complexion darker than night sky, mid 30s goddess, curvy petite physique THE MOST EXTREME PHYSICALLY POSSIBLE beyond all anatomy limits — smallest most compact frame possible yet curves exploding at absolute maximum in every direction, bubble butt projecting dramatically backward from the tiny frame, thighs so thick they dwarf the petite frame, silver-white natural hair swept into a high sculpted crown — her LEFT side is dominated by butterfly scales (thousands of microscopic powder-fine scales layered like overlapping roof tiles, each scale individually distinct catching its own glint), BLAZING ELECTRIC BLUE scale formations, VIVID DEEP BLACK scale-edge detail, every scale catching its own glint and casting its own small shadow. Her RIGHT side is dominated by solid thick stained glass fused to her form, hundreds of small individual panes each no larger than a coin, BLAZING ELECTRIC CRIMSON and VIVID GOLD panes alternating in a dense irregular mosaic, dark lead-line seams webbing between every pane. Rather than a sharp boundary, the two materials interweave and overlap gradually across a soft irregular zone a few inches wide down the centre of her body, elements of each scattered into the other's territory, density fading rather than stopping abruptly, no fabric no seam no garment anywhere, every material fused to or erupting from her own living skin, covering her completely with no bare skin anywhere from neck to ankle. Pose: strong hip pop right, both hands pressing sides of hips outward simultaneously arching back to extreme, both halves of her body clearly visible — most extreme curvy petite silhouette ever displayed.
#2: extreme platform heels/boots blending the relevant materials at her feet, extra long nails each matching whichever zone that hand falls in.

Environment: MANDATORY pure pitch black void background only, absolutely NO studio backdrop NO texture NO grey NO gradient.
All: Extreme macro detail on every material and every blended transition. CRITICAL: all 2 women's legs must show FULL BODY ART coverage from hip to ankle to toe with NO bare untattooed skin visible anywhere. TWO completely different extreme physiques must CONTRAST and DOMINATE every inch of frame. 8K portrait 3:4 aspect ratio.
